# Ezily

> Know your customer, close the sale, run every channel. It starts on LINE and isn't bound to LINE.

Every page is published in American English at https://ezily.io/ and in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) at https://ezily.io/zh.

## English

### Overview

- [Ezily](https://ezily.io/): Know your customer, close the sale, run every channel. It starts on LINE and isn't bound to LINE.

### Touchpoints

- [Conversion Best Practices](https://ezily.io/conversion-best-practices): Customers arrive with a specific reason and land on a page built for everyone. Here is how e-commerce brands actually lift conversion on LINE.
- [Engagement Best Practices](https://ezily.io/engagement-best-practices): Customers looked, asked, joined the activation, and your list still shows a blank. Here is how e-commerce brands actually run engagement on LINE.
- [LINE Mini App for E-commerce Businesses](https://ezily.io/line-mini-app): A LINE Mini App lets customers complete a whole purchase inside LINE with no download and no signup. Here is how it differs from LIFF, what e-commerce brands use it for, and what building one actually involves.
- [Ezily Touchpoints](https://ezily.io/touchpoints): Meet customers where they already are, tag them, and close the sale. LINE is the first surface.

### Orchestrate

- [Ezily Orchestrate](https://ezily.io/orchestrate): Momo, Shopee, and the channels you own. Products, inventory, pricing, and orders in one place. Open a channel without staffing one.

### Notes

- [Notes on running an e-commerce business](https://ezily.io/blog): LINE, CRM, and cross-channel operations. We write about the work we actually do.
- [Five reasons Taiwan e-commerce brands should build a LINE Mini App](https://ezily.io/blog/5-reasons-why-e-commerce-businesses-in-taiwan-should-build-a-line-mini-app): No download, no signup, and service messages that don't depend on friend status. Five reasons, once.
- [How to Increase E-commerce Repeat Purchases: 5 Things Brands Need to Rethink About Lead Nurturing and Retention](https://ezily.io/blog/ecommerce-repeat-purchase-lead-nurturing): Want to improve ecommerce repeat purchases without relying on discounts alone? It's not a vendor problem. It's a data boundary. Use Ezily's Visibility Layers framework to diagnose.
- [LINE CRM Is Not About Adding More Tags: A Segmentation and Automation Guide for Ecommerce Brands](https://ezily.io/blog/line-crm-tags): Learn how ecommerce brands can use LINE CRM tags, segmentation, and automation to send smarter messages, improve retention, and reduce broadcast waste.
- [LINE Mini App for E-commerce: Five Major Shifts for Taiwan’s Brand E-commerce](https://ezily.io/blog/line-mini-app-ecommerce-taiwan): LINE Mini App is changing how Taiwan e-commerce brands interact with customers. - [Set a goal that actually moves revenue](https://ezily.io/blog/setting-e-commerce-goals-that-actually-move-revenue): Specific goals work. How to break one into numbers you can see every week.

### Careers

- [Careers](https://ezily.io/careers): Customers buy once and turn into an order, then the brand pays to reach the same person again. We're building the part that keeps them.
- [(Senior) Customer Success Manager](https://ezily.io/careers/customer-success-manage): Own the customer from onboarding through renewal as brands move their products, inventory, and orders onto Orchestrate.
- [Lead Frontend Engineer](https://ezily.io/careers/frontend-engineering-lead): Decide the frontend architecture and write the code, streaming interfaces for the AI features included.
- [Full Stack Engineer](https://ezily.io/careers/full-stack-engineer): Build features end to end across Touchpoints and Orchestrate, and stay responsible for what you ship.
- [Senior Designer](https://ezily.io/careers/senior-designer): Own Ezily's design language and one component library across two products, turning complex commerce workflows into interfaces that feel simple.
- [Senior DevOps Engineer](https://ezily.io/careers/senior-devops): Own the reliability, scalability, and security of the AWS infrastructure both products run on, from Terraform modules through CI/CD to incident response.
- [Senior Product Manager](https://ezily.io/careers/senior-product-manager): Own one area inside Orchestrate, whether product catalog sync, bundles, or inventory operations, and set its direction rather than its schedule.
- [Senior Sales and Business Development Manager](https://ezily.io/careers/senior-sales-and-bd): Own the commercial pipeline end to end, from self-sourced leads through negotiation and close, against an individual revenue target.

## 繁體中文

### Overview

- [Ezily](https://ezily.io/zh): 認識顧客、完成成交、管好通路。從 LINE 開始，不綁在 LINE。

### Touchpoints

- [轉換優化最佳實務](https://ezily.io/zh/conversion-best-practices): 客人帶著具體的理由點進來，卻看到一個為所有人準備的頁面。這篇整理電商品牌在 LINE 上提高轉換的實際做法。
- [互動經營最佳實務](https://ezily.io/zh/engagement-best-practices): 客人看了、問了、參加了活動，然後在你的名單上還是一片空白。這篇整理電商品牌在 LINE 上經營互動的實際做法。
- [LINE Mini App 是什麼，電商品牌為什麼要用](https://ezily.io/zh/line-mini-app): 免下載、免註冊，客人在 LINE 裡完成整段購物流程。這篇說明它和 LIFF 的差別、電商能用它做什麼，以及實際要處理的事。
- [Ezily Touchpoints](https://ezily.io/zh/touchpoints): 在客人已經在的地方認識他、留下標籤、完成成交。第一個場是 LINE。

### Orchestrate

- [Ezily Orchestrate](https://ezily.io/zh/orchestrate): Momo、Shopee 和你自己的通路，商品、庫存、價格、訂單在一個地方管完。多開一個通路是設定，不是招人。

### Notes

- [電商經營筆記](https://ezily.io/zh/blog): LINE、CRM、跨通路營運。我們寫我們自己在做的事。
- [台灣電商品牌該做 LINE Mini App 的五個理由](https://ezily.io/zh/blog/5-reasons-why-e-commerce-businesses-in-taiwan-should-build-a-line-mini-app): 免下載、免註冊、服務訊息不受好友狀態限制。五個理由，一次講完。
- [電商回購怎麼做？從潛在客戶經營到熟客路徑，品牌該重新思考的 5 件事](https://ezily.io/zh/blog/ecommerce-repeat-purchase-lead-nurturing): 電商品牌該怎麼提升回購，不再只靠折扣？這篇文章從潛在客戶經營、熟客路徑、CRM 分群到回購策略，整理品牌現在最該重視的 5 個經營重點。
- [LINE chatbot 已經不夠聰明了嗎？用「能見度三層級」診斷你卡在哪一層](https://ezily.io/zh/blog/line-chatbot-visibility-layers-2026): 你的 LINE chatbot 答不出「我在 Shopee 買的到貨了嗎」？問題不在選錯廠商，是卡在 data boundary。用 Ezily 的「Chatbot 能見度三層級」5 題自我診斷，看清下一步該升級工具還是 data architecture。
- [LINE CRM 不是貼更多標籤：電商品牌的分眾標籤架構與自動化推播指南](https://ezily.io/zh/blog/line-crm-tags): 給台灣電商品牌的 LINE CRM 指南，說明如何用標籤、分眾、TAGS 框架與合規資料治理，建立可落地的 LINE 官方帳號會員經營策略。
- [LINE Mini App 電商新局：台灣品牌電商與顧客互動的五大改變](https://ezily.io/zh/blog/line-mini-app-ecommerce-taiwan): LINE Mini App 的出現，正在改變台灣品牌電商與顧客互動的方式。這不只是多一個新平台，而是讓 LINE 從訊息通路，進一步走向互動、會員、服務與 OMO 的核心位置。這篇文章會從資深電商品牌顧問的角度，拆解 LINE Mini App 帶來的五大改變，以及台灣品牌最值得把握的三大關鍵機會。
- [多通路電商怎麼管：五個實際做法](https://ezily.io/zh/blog/mastering-multi-channel-e-commerce-key-strategies-for-success): 商品、庫存、價格、訂單散在各通路的時候，先處理哪一個。
- [訂一個真的會影響營收的目標](https://ezily.io/zh/blog/setting-e-commerce-goals-that-actually-move-revenue): 目標訂得具體才有用。怎麼把目標拆成每週看得到的數字。
- [Shopify 台灣案例怎麼看？品牌主別只學網站設計，還要學怎麼把顧客留下來](https://ezily.io/zh/blog/shopify-taiwan-cases-line-retention): 搜尋 Shopify 台灣案例時，不只看版型、App 與設計。本文用簡單方法拆解台灣品牌如何把 Shopify 官網流量變成 LINE 好友、顧客偏好資料與下一次回購機會。

### Careers

- [人才招募](https://ezily.io/zh/careers): 客人買完就變成一筆訂單，品牌再付錢找同一個人。我們在做的是讓那個人留下來。
- [(Senior) Customer Success Manager](https://ezily.io/zh/careers/customer-success-manage): 負責客戶從導入到續約的整段過程。品牌把商品、庫存和訂單交給 Orchestrate 管，中間怎麼調整由你判斷。
- [Lead Frontend Engineer](https://ezily.io/zh/careers/frontend-engineering-lead): 決定前端架構，也實際動手寫，包含 AI 功能的串流回應介面。
- [Full Stack Engineer](https://ezily.io/zh/careers/full-stack-engineer): 端到端開發 Touchpoints 和 Orchestrate 的功能，並且對自己上線的東西負責到底。
- [Senior Designer](https://ezily.io/zh/careers/senior-designer): 負責整間公司的設計語言和設計系統，兩個產品共用一套元件，把複雜的電商流程做成簡單的介面。
- [Senior DevOps Engineer](https://ezily.io/zh/careers/senior-devops): 負責兩個產品所在的 AWS 基礎架構，從 Terraform 模組、CI/CD 到事故處理，扛穩定、擴展和安全。
- [Senior Product Manager](https://ezily.io/zh/careers/senior-product-manager): 負責 Orchestrate 裡的一塊：商品主檔同步、組合商品，或庫存營運。這個位置決定方向，不是排時程。
- [Senior Sales and Business Development Manager](https://ezily.io/zh/careers/senior-sales-and-bd): 從開發名單、談判到成交，負責整段業務流程，並且扛個人業績目標。
